definition: Model-class-different nearest neighbors are proposed hard negatives, not ground truth. Same-structure judgment on a proposed negative measures false separation. Actual false acceptance uses source-judged different pairs. Unknowns are not positive agreement.
limitation: Single-agent source judgments, not independent inter-rater reproducibility. Native crops can include adjacent ink; uncertain parent ownership remains unknown.
freeze_failure: Threshold assignment stability below registered minimum; pair audit may also expose over-specific partitions/false acceptance.
